name: @loontail/launcher-strapi
//overrides: Force a single copy of @strapi/admin across the whole tree. The exact-pin family in @strapi/strapi + @strapi/core can lag a minor behind the ranged deps in the other @strapi/* sub-packages (content-manager, i18n, email, upload, plugin-cloud, …), and the two versions end up side by side. Two copies means two React contexts created by `createContext('Auth')`; AuthProvider mounts on one, useAuth reads from the other, the selector returns undefined, and admin chunks blow up with `checkUserHasPermissions is not a function`. Bump this in lock-step with the top-level @strapi/strapi pin.
